market_summary: Wall Street closed Thursday higher after recovering from early losses: S&P 500 7,666 (+0.2%), Nasdaq 26,872 (+0.04%), Dow 50,927 (+0.04%), VIX 16.4. The 10-year ended near 5.25% after touching a 24-year high of 5.34%, and October hike odds fell to about 25-29% after Fed Vice Chair Jefferson said the Fed may need more time. Fed Governor Cook named the AI buildout the top inflation risk for 2027, while Dallas Fed's Logan still wants 50bp or more of hikes. Asia is lower Friday: Nikkei -0.7%, MSCI Asia ex-Japan -0.5%, ASX 200 +0.5%, AUD/USD about 0.69; Brent about $102.50 and WTI about $92.85 with US-Iran talks stuck on sequencing and Washington pressing France and Germany on diesel stocks. Next 48h (AEST): Tesla Q3 deliveries before the US open Friday (consensus about 462k); US September payrolls Friday 22:30 (consensus about 84-93k, unemployment 4.1%); OPEC+ Sunday, expected to hold November targets; Sydney clocks go to AEDT at 02:00 Sunday; ISM services Tuesday 01:00 AEDT.

AMZN.reason: Down 0.4% on the day and up 0.3% after hours, steadier than most of the tape. Goldman's conviction-list call and the redesigned Kindle line add nothing new to the thesis; AWS growth of 37% is still what matters.

AXOS.reason: Up 1.2% as bonds rallied into the close and mortgage rates fell, with no company news. Q1 FY27 results on Oct 29 are the next catalyst and the deposit and credit picture is unchanged.

BABA.reason: Down 0.09% and +0.17% after hours. Class action notices keep landing ahead of the Oct. 5 lead-plaintiff deadline, alleging undisclosed Chinese military ties and AI distillation. Stay on the sidelines until the legal picture clears.

ENPH.reason: Down 0.5% on a quiet day with no company news, even as yields eased. Residential solar still needs lower rates to improve; wait for the Q3 report before acting.

FIGR.reason: Down 1.1% while the other mortgage names bounced, with no company news. Aletheia's new Buy and BofA's upgrade earlier this month support the story, and the Kiavi and Sierra moves are intact.

GOOGL.reason: Down 1.70% on the Gemini 4 Argon launch day, a sell-the-news dip rather than a change in the story. The orbital TPU test launched, and analysts stayed bullish. A lower entry on an unchanged thesis.

LDI.reason: Up 3.7% (and 2.1% more after hours) as the 30-year mortgage rate fell 6bp to 7.54%, but it is still under the NYSE price threshold and one rate dip is a bounce, not a trend. Keep trimming into strength.

META.reason: Flat at +0.10% after a 27% September run, its best month since 2022. New Mexico asking up to $40 billion in penalties is a headline risk, though the judge has not ruled. Hold while the Muse momentum and the legal overhang offset.

MRVL.reason: Up 1.46% Thursday and +0.60% after hours, following the broader AI chip bid. No company news since the 2nm optical demos and GlobalFoundries capacity deal earlier in the month. Hold.

MU.reason: Rebounded 3.03% Thursday after a roughly 3% post-earnings slip, giving back 0.66% after hours. Cantor put a target of $2,000 on it, but the market is not rewarding the beat the way it used to. Hold and let the dust settle.

NFLX.reason: Down 2.5% after Sarandos said growth is slower than he wants; Wells Fargo went Underweight with a price target of $57, while Guggenheim's target raise to $80 pulls the other way. The Oct 20 report decides it.

NVDA.reason: Up 1.09% Thursday with after-hours flat at +0.27%, rising alongside AMD and Intel on the Micron print. No new company-specific catalyst since the morning run; the stock keeps trending with the sector, so nothing to add or trim.

RKT.reason: Up 4.0% as the 30-year mortgage rate fell 6bp to 7.54%, the first drop of any size in weeks. One day does not rebuild refi volume; Friday's jobs report decides whether the bond rally holds.

TSM.reason: Up 0.66% and flat after hours. Q3 results land Oct. 15 with analysts expecting about 47% revenue growth, and Texas expansion talk adds to the US build-out. Still the cleanest AI foundry exposure.

STRIPE.reason: No new round or tender reported. The newsroom's latest posts are the Sept 30 Japan, Parafin and OUSD items, all already covered. Mark stays at the last tender.

OPENAI.reason: SoftBank closed the last $10B tranche of its earlier $30B commitment (13% stake), which is not a new round; the raise at $1.4T is still only reported as talks. A California subpoena and the FTC probe add regulatory risk. Mark unchanged.

headlines: Tonight AEST: US payrolls 10:30pm, consensus only 84-93k after August's 162k; Tesla Q3 deliveries before the US open, consensus 462k.
Wall Street recovered Thursday: S&P 500 +0.2%, 10-year back to 5.25% after a 24-year high; October Fed hike odds near 27%.
Micron rebounded 3.0%, Marvell 1.5% and Nvidia 1.1%; Alphabet slipped 1.7% on Gemini 4 launch day. No take changes.
Mortgage rates eased to 7.54%: Rocket up 4.0%, loanDepot 3.7%, Axos 1.2%; Netflix fell 2.5% after a Wells Fargo Underweight.
Anthropic IPO reportedly: investor day Oct 14, marketing from Nov 9, debut before Thanksgiving, valuation target up to $2T.
BYD fell 2.5% in Hong Kong despite record 2026 September sales; Fed's Cook named the AI buildout the top 2027 inflation risk.
